name: Mangy Claw
summary: In Dun Morogh, Mangy Claw marks the end of a deadly hunt. The great ice claw bear Mangeclaw killed a stranded dwarven pilot, and the severed claw proves the beast was slain.

sections.title: A Dying Pilot's Wish
sections.body: Pilot Hildelve’s steam tank broke down in Dun Morogh’s frozen hills. He searched for ore on foot and faced the mountain wilderness alone. In his journal, he tells how he fought off Mangeclaw, an ice claw bear, but was savagely mauled. The bear returned and killed the weakened pilot. Hildelve’s final entry pleaded for vengeance. Taking Mangy Claw from the fallen bear fulfills his request.

sections.title: Vengeance for the Siege Brigade
sections.body: Pilot Hammerfoot sent searchers into the snowdrifts, hoping to find his friend Hildelve alive. Hildelve’s journal and Mangy Claw show that he died and his final request was honored. Bringing them to Hammerfoot gives the Ironforge Siege Brigade closure and earns the gratitude of Ironforge’s pilots.

faq.answer: Mangy Claw is the severed claw of Mangeclaw, a savage ice claw bear in Dun Morogh. It proves the beast was hunted and killed.
Pilot Hammerfoot wants Mangy Claw and the journal of his fallen friend Hildelve. They confirm that the killer bear is dead. Hammerfoot is stationed near Dun Morogh’s mountain passes.

faq.q: Why did Mangeclaw need to be hunted?
faq.answer: Mangeclaw mauled and eventually killed Hildelve, a dwarf pilot searching for ore on foot after his steam tank broke down. Hildelve’s journal records his dying wish for someone to avenge him.

faq.q: Where does the beast Mangeclaw roam?
faq.answer: Mangeclaw prowls Dun Morogh’s snowy ridges and hills, near where Pilot Hildelve’s remains were found.

angles.text: As a dwarf, honoring a fallen comrade’s dying wish and avenging a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade carry deep personal and clan honor.
As a hunter, tracking Mangeclaw through Dun Morogh’s brutal mountain blizzards tests your skill against dangerous, territorial beasts.
